deliveryFlow.shareIt: You pass it to the recipient by SMS, WhatsApp or in person.

protection.title: Protection
protection.subtitle: State what the contents are worth, then choose your cover.

basic.title: Basic protection
basic.description: Your money is held until delivery, parcel not handed over refunded.

extended.title: Yamba Guarantee {cap}
extended.description: Loss, theft or damage in transit, refunded up to {cap}.
extended.exclusionsText: Prohibited goods, a parcel that does not match its description, customs seizure, and normal wear.

content.subtitle: Describe what you are sending, and show it.
content.descriptionHint: It helps the Traveler recognise the parcel at handover.

errors.DESCRIPTION_TOO_SHORT: Briefly describe the contents (5 characters minimum).
errors.PHOTOS_REQUIRED_WITH_GUARANTEE: At least one photo is required with the Yamba Guarantee.

goldenRules.title: The golden rules for a smooth shipment
goldenRules.pack: Pack carefully: a sturdy bag or box, bubble wrap for fragile items, taped properly.
goldenRules.weigh: Weigh precisely: the declared weight must match the real weight at handover.
goldenRules.describe: Describe faithfully: {name} will check the contents before accepting your parcel.

content.cameraDeniedBody: Yamba needs the camera to photograph your parcel. You can allow it in settings.

charter.title: Your commitment
charter.subtitle: You certify the contents of the parcel on your honour.

handover.title: At handover, here is what will happen
handover.visualInspection: The Traveler will inspect your parcel before accepting. Do not be surprised.
handover.refusalPossibleLead: Refusal is possible if it does not match.
handover.refusalPossible: If the contents differ from your declaration, the Traveler may refuse. You will be refunded, but the trip will be lost.
handover.crossPhotos: The Traveler will take their own photos, which will prevail in a dispute.

pledge.title: Shipper Charter
pledge.subtitle: A legal commitment, read it carefully.
pledge.intro: By confirming your booking, you declare and warrant on your honour that your parcel:
pledge.noIllicit: contains no illicit, dangerous or prohibited goods,
pledge.matchDeclared: matches exactly the category, weight and contents declared,
pledge.customsCompliant: complies with the customs obligations of the destination country.
pledge.disclaimer: Any false declaration engages your sole civil and criminal liability, excluding that of the Traveler and Yamba.
pledge.fullLink: See the full charter and prohibited goods

accept.label: I accept the Shipper Charter, the Terms and the Transport Contract.
accept.error: You must accept the charter to continue.

payment.title: Payment
payment.subtitle: The amount is authorised now, and only charged when the Traveler accepts.
payment.hold: Nothing is charged now. The Traveler has 24 hours to accept: that is when you pay.
payment.testMode: Test mode: no payment provider is configured on this machine. The {amount} authorisation is simulated.
payment.cardPending: The payment sheet opens when you tap Pay.
payment.cardAuthorized: Card authorised. Your request still has to be sent.
payment.unavailableTitle: Card payment is not available in this version
payment.unavailableBody: It cannot open the payment sheet. Your entries are kept: come back once the app is up to date.

after.step1: The Traveler receives your request and has 24 hours to accept. You are only charged then.
after.step2: Meet the Traveler for the handover, which they will check and photograph.
after.step3: Once the parcel is handed over, you receive your 6-digit code to pass on to the recipient.
after.step4: The recipient gives the code to the Traveler on arrival, who enters it to confirm delivery.
after.step5: 3 days after the confirmed delivery, the Traveler receives their payment.

payment.trust: Payment secured by Stripe. Yamba never stores your card details.
payment.notReady: Payment is being prepared, one moment.

errors.SHEET_FAILED: The payment could not be authorised. Check your card and try again.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: A photo could not be sent. Check your connection and try again. Nothing was charged.
errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: A photo is over {maxMb} MB. Remove it or take it again. Nothing was charged.
errors.UPLOAD_INVALID_TYPE: A photo is in an unsupported format. Nothing was charged.
errors.QUOTE_DIVERGENCE: The price changed since your quote. The new total is shown: check it before paying.
errors.QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE: The quote cannot be computed for this parcel. Go back to the weight and size.
errors.CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: There is no longer enough room on this trip for your parcel.
errors.FAMILY_REFUSED: The Traveler does not accept this content on this trip.
errors.TRIP_NOT_BOOKABLE: This trip no longer accepts requests.
errors.OWN_TRIP: You cannot book your own trip.
errors.NEW_ACCOUNT_CAP: Your account is new: your shipments are still capped. The cap lifts with your first completed shipments.
errors.PAYMENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED: The payment has not been authorised yet. Try again.
errors.PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The authorisation no longer matches your request. A new one is being prepared.
errors.PAYMENT_ALREADY_USED: This payment is already attached to a request.
errors.ACCOUNT_DELETED: This account has been deleted: the request was not created.
errors.SESSION: Your session has expired. Sign in again: your entries are kept.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: Your account is suspended. Contact support to find out more.
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Nothing was charged, you can try again.

confirmation.title: Request sent
confirmation.subtitle: {name} has 24 hours to accept. You are only charged then.

next.step1: If they accept, you are charged and the handover meeting is confirmed.
next.step2: At the handover, they check and photograph the parcel. You receive your 6-digit code.
next.step3: The recipient gives that code on arrival: it is what confirms the delivery.

confirmation.refused: If they refuse or do not answer within 24 hours, the authorisation lapses on its own and you have paid nothing.
